description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Layout' which serves as a reusable layout component for a web application. It includes navigation features like a back arrow, displays a header with a title, and renders child content within styled containers. It also imports and uses external components such as NavBar and an icon from Material UI.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: React functional component that renders the overall page layout, including navigation, header, back button, and content area.
